name: ESP32-S3 + C6 over WiFi
label: ESP32-S3 with 16 MB flash and 8 MB PSRAM (e.g. ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N16R8) plus an ESP32-C6 as the 802.15.4 radio over WiFi, with no cable between them (read the limits in docs/ap-netradio.md first)
antenna: on the module or external (u.FL), per module; the C6 radio has its own
